title: Download the Course Syllabus
summary: Short resource page with a single button linking to a PDF of the full course syllabus (hosted on Google Drive). No teaching content.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: The syllabus PDF lists every topic in the bootcamp. Use it to see where each module sits and to choose a starting point if you already know some of the material.
The download is a Google Drive link. If it fails, the article explains that heavy traffic is the usual cause and a later retry normally works.
(Extra) A copy of the syllabus is also in the reference repo as 'Section 01 - Front-End Web Development/01.01 - Web Dev Syllabus.pdf'.

(Extra) The reference repo's folder names give a quick map of the course order: HTML, intermediate HTML, multi-page sites, CSS (intro, properties, intermediate, advanced), Flexbox, Grid, Bootstrap, web design, a personal-site capstone, JavaScript ES6, DOM, two 'boss level' games (Dicee, Simon), jQuery, Unix command line, Node, Express, EJS, Git/GitHub, APIs, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, React, then Web3/ICP DApps.

playground.coverage: No playground lesson yet (download page only).
